description.text: The first set of the Sword & Shield series and of the eighth generation, released on 7 February 2020 with 216 cards: 202 and 14 secret rares. It replaced Pokémon-GX with Pokémon V, and brought in Pokémon VMAX, enormous Pokémon into which some Pokémon V, such as Snorlax and Stonjourner, evolve. Its Pokémon come from Galar, among them Grookey, Scorbunny and Sobble, Galarian forms of older Pokémon, and the Legendary Zacian and Zamazenta. In the West it was the first set with a regulation mark, the letter on each card that decides its legality, starting with D.
